messages:
Priya (AE): Zenith's procurement asked for our pen test PDF + verified vulnerability scan exports and a compact remediation timeline for their SOC. They need owners and dates, and request the raw scan logs if possible. Can we agree scope of what to share?
Ben R. (SE): I can assemble the report and the Qualys export. Proposed artifacts: `zenith-pen-2026-05.pdf`, `qualys-export-zenith-2026.csv`, `remediation-timeline-1768004321.csv`.
Lina K. (Security): We can share the full PDF but must redact internal management IPs and any customer-identifiable logs. Do NOT include exploit payloads or PoC scripts. Provide scanner configs and the command lines, scrubbed.
Priya (AE): They asked explicitly for an onboarding-friendly timeline (date buckets + owner + risk). Can we produce that as a calendar CSV?
Marta (Eng Ops): Yes, I'll create a calendar CSV view. For the three critical items (CVE-2025-4821 kernel -> host, improper auth on /internal-api, and exposed S3 bucket perms) owners and ETA: CVE-2025-4821 fix by 2026-06-04 (owner: Marta), /internal-api auth by 2026-05-29 (owner: Ben R.), S3 perms by 2026-05-31 (owner: Storage Team).
Ben R. (SE): Retest window: staging retest 2026-06-06 to 2026-06-09. Acceptance criteria: no criticals, <=2 mediums.
Lina K. (Security): Provide scanner fingerprint (policy name + timestamp) rather than raw creds. Example line: `qualys_scan --policy "redwood-standard" --asset-group zenith-2026-05 --export csv`. Strip headers with customer emails.
Priya (AE): Legal also asked for a short data handling statement and whether we can release raw logs under NDA.
Lina K. (Security): We'll state: "Raw exploit artifacts and sensitive logs withheld; available under mutual NDA and designated transfer process." Also include SHA256 of each shared file.
Ben R. (SE): I'll run quick greps to scrub emails and account ids before export: `egrep -i "@|account_id|user_id|customer_email" qualys-export-zenith-2026.csv || true` then manual review.
OpsBot: Artifact staged: /artifacts/1768004321/zenith-pen-2026-05.pdf (3.7MB), /artifacts/1768004321/qualys-export-zenith-2026.csv (1.3MB), /artifacts/1768004321/remediation-timeline-1768004321.csv (18KB).
Marta (Eng Ops): I'll populate the remediation CSV with columns: date, owner, finding_id, short_description, risk, status, verification_steps. Then export a calendar CSV: `calendar-export-1768004321.csv`.
Priya (AE): Customer wants the list of stakeholders for verification. Can we add contact alias for each owner (no personal emails)?
Ben R. (SE): I'll add team aliases (e.g., storage@redwood-eng, infra@redwood-eng).
Lina K. (Security): Also include proposed SLAs: schedule retest within 7 business days of confirmation, remediation verification within 10 business days. Add a note: criticals will get priority emergency fixes.
Priya (AE): Nice. What's the plan for sending? I want to send a single package with a redaction cover note and an offer to share raw logs under NDA.
Marta (Eng Ops): I'm comfortable. I'll attach `zenith-pen-2026-05.pdf` (redacted), `qualys-export-zenith-2026.csv` (scrubbed), `remediation-timeline-1768004321.csv`, `scanner-configs-1768004321.txt` (sanitized), and `calendar-export-1768004321.csv`.
OpsBot: Uploaded checksums: `zenith-pen-2026-05.pdf: sha256:9d7f1a2b...`, `qualys-export-zenith-2026.csv: sha256:2c4b6e8d...`, `remediation-timeline-1768004321.csv: sha256:7a1c5e9f...`.
Priya (AE): I'll draft the email to Zenith and propose send time 08:00 PT tomorrow with a brief cover: redaction summary + how to request raw logs. I'll post the draft here for quick review. :thumbsup:
Ben R. (SE): Quick note: Zenith asked whether we can include our SIG/CAIQ summary in the package. Can we?
Lina K. (Security): Yes, include the SIG/CAIQ condensed matrix (no secrets). Add a line referencing our attestation and SOC status.
Priya (AE): Thanks all. I'll drop the email draft in ~45m.
Marta (Eng Ops): After Priya posts draft I'll check attachments and final redaction.
Priya (AE): Sending plan locked pending final scrub confirmation by Ben.
